data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element.

levels.name: Tw Inset Ring Shadow
levels.description: Tailwind reset/placeholder shadow with zero offset, zero blur, and transparent color. Used as a base value for shadow variables.

levels.name: Shadow Flyout
levels.description: Very subtle dual-layer shadow for flyout menus and dropdowns. First layer: 1rem blur at 2% black opacity. Second layer: 0.5rem blur at ~1% black opacity.

levels.name: Window Shadow
levels.description: Large dramatic shadow for floating window elements like the demo IDE windows. Two layers with 28px/70px blur and 14px/32px blur at 14% and 10% black opacity respectively, plus a 1px border ring.

levels.name: Window Shadow Large
levels.description: Extra large shadow for prominent floating elements with 22px/70px blur and 0.5px border ring at 30% and 15% black opacity.

levels.name: Card Inner Shadow
levels.description: Inner shadow for nested cards and containers with 25px blur, 12px spread variant, plus 0.5px border ring.

levels.name: iOS Glass Inner Highlight
levels.description: Glass-morphism effect with inner highlight at top, subtle inner shadow at bottom, and outer drop shadow for depth.
